subject: Re: Deployment & Data Residency — Nordbank follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Johan Eriksson <johan.eriksson@nordbank.se>, Sofia Lindgren <sofia.lindgren@nordbank.se>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-07-08T15:12:00Z
Subject: Deployment & Data Residency — follow-up (Nordbank)

Thanks for your time earlier, Johan and Sofia — appreciate the walkthrough of your EU+APAC rollout priorities. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we're all aligned: 

Call recap
- Primary requirement: EU-only data residency for customer data and model context for EU customers.
- Secondary requirement: APAC coverage for future expansion; low-latency in APAC is desirable but may be Phase 2.
- Constraint: cross-border routing (EU->APAC) is not permitted for PII; some anonymized telemetry is ok.
- Preference: if possible, keep production in Hosted EU region for time-to-value, explore Dedicated or Private VPC if strict network isolation is required.

Suggested next steps
1) I've attached our EU data residency FAQ and a draft SOW as discussed. Please review the residency checklist (attached) to flag any must-have items.
2) We'll propose two deployment options: (A) Hosted API pinned to EU region with strict routing policy + contractual commitments around data residency; (B) Private VPC (customer-managed) hosted in your cloud region for full network isolation.
3) Internal: I'll loop in Ethan (SE) to validate latency and routing constraints for the APAC pilot if you want to test multi-region behavior.
4) Procurement: if you want a procurement-ready SOW, we can send a version with pricing and a pilot term — cc'd procurement in a follow-up.

Would you prefer a short technical session (30 min) with Ethan this week to validate the Hosted vs Private tradeoffs? If so, share times that work.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0148

Attachments: EU-data-residency-faq.pdf, Nordbank_SOW_draft_v1.pdf

From: Johan Eriksson <johan.eriksson@nordbank.se>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sofia Lindgren <sofia.lindgren@nordbank.se>
Date: 2026-07-08T19:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Deployment & Data Residency — follow-up (Nordbank)

Thanks Marissa — good recap. Couple of clarifications before we schedule the SE call: 

1) Hosted EU: when you say Hosted API pinned to EU region, do you guarantee that model context (conversation history) and generated responses never leave EU data centers? We need contractual language and technical controls for that.
2) Private VPC: how much additional lead time and cost? Our security team tends to prefer VPC for corporate-sensitive models. Is Private on-prem (air-gapped) an option or would that be a separate engagement?
3) APAC: timeline is 6-9 months; for the pilot we may need a low latency path for APAC internal users. Would cross-region routing be possible with tokenization/anonymization for telemetry only?

Procurement: cc'ing procurement so they can flag any special contracting needs (e.g., data processing addendum, audit rights).

Also — can you send SOC2 evidence and any EU region SLA numbers?

Best,
Johan
Head of AI Platforms, Nordbank
johan.eriksson@nordbank.se

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Johan Eriksson <johan.eriksson@nordbank.se>, Sofia Lindgren <sofia.lindgren@nordbank.se>, procurement <procurement@nordbank.se>
Cc: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-07-09T09:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Deployment & Data Residency — follow-up (Nordbank)

Hi Johan — thanks. Quick answers and proposed plan below. I've attached a SOC2 stub and an EU SLA summary for your legal/security review.

Answers:
- Hosted EU guarantee: We can pin the Hosted API to EU regions only and provide contractual Data Processing Addendum language restricting cross-border transfer of model context and customer data. Technical controls include region-scoped routing and no replication to non-EU zones for pinned deployments. We do contractually commit to that for Hosted EU pinned customers.
- Private VPC / on-prem: Private VPC in your cloud region (customer-managed networking) is available and typically adds 2-6 weeks for setup (depending on networking/peering). Fully air-gapped on-prem is a separate engagement (longer lead time and procurement). We can scope that if needed.
- APAC pilot: For Phase 1 we recommend Hosted EU for EU customers and a separate APAC-hosted instance for APAC traffic when latency is critical. Cross-region routing with anonymized telemetry is possible as long as PII is stripped before egress; we can validate with your security team.

Proposed next steps:
1) Technical deep-dive (30 min) with Ethan this Friday (Jul 10): cover routing controls, key management options (KMS/HSM), and latency expectations. Proposed slots: 09:00 or 13:00 CEST.
2) Procurement: I'll attach a SOW draft — if procurement can share contract priorities we'll inline them into the next SOW.
3) Security: we'll provide SOC2 type II evidence and a short residency checklist for your security review (attached).

If that plan looks good I'll confirm the SE session and get Ethan to prepare an architecture sketch for Hosted vs Private options.

Thanks,
Marissa

Attachments: SOC2_type2_stub.pdf, EU-data-residency-faq.pdf
